nested_random_design.original_1200R_each_tracer_cap_id: A02 unchanged approved source-sha verified deterministic selected 1200 original randoms. No new FITS random selection; use only fixed 1200.
nested_random_design.permutation_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(1200) with PCG64, indices sorted back to original A02 row order before computing pairs.
nested_random_design.permutation_seed_formula: 20402026 + 100000*mock_ID + 1000*cap_index + 100*tracer_index, cap_index NGC=0 SGC=1, tracer_index LRG=0 ELG=1
nested_random_design.half_B_600: sorted permutation positions [600:1200]; disjoint complement of A for each tracer separately
nested_random_design.three_quarter_A_900: sorted permutation positions [0:900], nested with half_A_600
nested_random_design.full_1200: all 1200 originally sampled random rows unchanged, original order exactly, original E2 SHA fingerprints
nested_random_design.limits: 600/900/1200 is finite original-1200 subset stability and disjoint half scatter only. NOT convergence toward infinite random density or a physical survey window; additional 2400/4800 from original FITS requires separate future prereg.

E2_weight_stress_replay.formula: u(z)=2*(z-0.9)/0.1-1; ONLY selected ELG RANDOM weight w'(z)=w(z)*(1±0.05*u(z)); unchanged rows/positions/chunks and LRG randoms and both DATA. Recompute all four independent pair normalizations for each scenario.

synthetic_pair_histogram_injection.scope: MOCK-ONLY post-pair-binning DD-histogram synthetic odd probe, NOT physically realized galaxy wake or injection into observed data; does not change any galaxy/random input.
synthetic_pair_histogram_injection.rule_forward: h_D_LD_E^inj(s,mu_bin)=h_D_LD_E(s,mu_bin)*(1+amplitude*mu_bin_center) on the same already computed DD pair hist; leave original full-data DD norm and all DR/RD/RR h and norms unchanged
synthetic_pair_histogram_injection.rule_reverse: For opposite ELG->LRG orientation apply opposite amplitude to reversed DD histogram, so an LRG->ELG signed dipole remains parity-consistent under tracer swap.
synthetic_pair_histogram_injection.analytic_estimator_increment_on_positive: delta_xi_inj(s,mu)=amplitude*mu_bin_center * [h_DD(s,mu)/N_DD]/[h_RR(s,mu)/N_RR], evaluated only on original positive-RR-supported cells.
synthetic_pair_histogram_injection.validation: Full 144 RR cells required to project ell0/1/2/3 physical signed-mu multipoles, otherwise report only directly supported cellwise injection increment and sparse masks; no fill or projection of incomplete cells. Injected pair-level perturbation cannot certify physical galaxy source/window recovery.

support_and_reporting.common_support_vs_full: Report count and max/median absolute xi baseline difference on cell intersection only. Explicitly exclude absent RR cells; do not present as full window convergence.

support_and_reporting.ensemble_summaries: All 18 cases in fixed order and separate caps; no ranking, no outcome-dependent choosing of subset, seed, cap, s-bin, tracer or plus/minus.

synthetic_negative_controls: Tamper original uploaded E2 SHA: source-only preflight rejects
Disjoint-half overlap or nonnested 900 selection: reject
Incorrect original 1200 subset or accepted-pair/source SHA: reject
Tampered separately normalized cross-LS random term: synthetic constant global random scale must not alter xi; unnormalized does
Synthetic DD-injection applied without reverse sign flip: reflected xi fails on positive support
Any unsupported RR cell is never given xi or projected multipoles
No binary FITS available in CI means no real E3 completion claim

excluded: Observed galaxy/random FITS rows and observed odd data vector
New hard mask/selection cut or shifted tracer/redshift/LOS geometry
New random FITS source files, replacing original SHA, new official release or downloads
Using nine mocks as a full 18D inference covariance
p-value, sigma, physical wake detection or model exclusion

failure_policy: First missing pinned input SHA before FITS stops whole run. Original 0001 parent replay failure stops before other IDs. Case error records exact original ID/cap and preserves checkpoint without dropping case or changing seed/size. Full COMPLETE means all 18 fixed cases finished, even if documented lower-density RR holes preclude projections; failure of 1200 baseline 144/144 support blocks that case.
synthetic_CI_scope: Read only archived JSON/protocol/source data; check deterministic synthetic subset nesting, disjointness, finite-RR support policy, 4-term independently normalized LS, signed odd injected DD parity and exact increment. CI never reads local realistic FITS and must not claim actual nine-ID E3 success.
